How to make a token

1. On github.com, open Settings › Developer settings › Personal access tokens › Fine-grained tokens › Generate new token.
2. Repository access: Only select repositories › forkcast.
3. Permissions › Repository permissions › Contents: Read-only.
4. Pick an expiration, generate, copy the token, and paste it here.

It stays encrypted on this phone and is only sent to GitHub when Forkcast checks for updates.
